entities.title: Every falsehood has a conformance scenario
entities.summary: Each of the 62 falsehoods in spec/FALSEHOODS-MATRIX.md has a scenario stating the safeguard and the specification sections that prevent it.
entities.statement: A complete implementation MUST add executable tests for every falsehood ID; until then each scenario records the design safeguard, the specification sections and its status.
acceptanceCriteria: falsehoods.json and the matrix list the same ids (tools/validate.py).

origin.description: Every row specifies a semantics decision and a planned test case.

entities.title: Standards constructs have conformance scenarios
entities.summary: 32 scenarios, STD-001 to STD-032, state the expected design outcome for constructs of the published standards UTV converges on.
entities.statement: Each scenario names its category, source standard and expected design outcome, so an implementation claiming the matching profile can test it.
acceptanceCriteria: Every scenario has id, category, scenario, expectedDesignOutcome, sourceStandard and status (tools/validate.py).

origin.description: The standards review of draft v4.
